Definition: a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
BiblicalUsage: 1) clan, family; 1a) clan; 1a1) family; 1a2) tribe; 1a3) people, nation; 1b) guild; 1c) species, kind; 1d) aristocrats
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
